subject: East Coast Roadshow — joint booth & MDF coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Morales <sarah@marketwiseevents.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>; Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0400
Subject: East Coast Roadshow — initial MDF & booth ask

Hi Stephanie / Vanessa,

Thanks for confirming interest in the East Coast Roadshow (Boston / NYC stops). Quick summary of what we can offer and what we need from Redwood to lock the joint package: 

- MDF: we typically co-invest at a 60/40 split (MarketWise covers 60%). For partners of your size we can offer a 50/50 match up to $25,000 if you commit to the 4-city run.
- Booth: shared 10x20 shell with one monitor, counter, and carpet. Additional furniture or custom backwall is billed separately.
- Lead handling: MarketWise will provide badge-scan CSVs within 48 hours. If you want direct MQL pushes into your CRM, we can do an API delivery for an additional $500 per event.
- Deadlines: branded assets (logo + 2 social banners) due 21 days prior to each stop; crate arrival window is 10 days before the first city.

I've attached a draft SOW and the booth spec sheet so you can see exact dimensions and power points. Please confirm: 1) MDF preference (standard 60/40 or 50/50 special), 2) whether you want the API lead delivery, and 3) if you plan to ship Redwood collateral or use MarketWise local storage.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Morales
Partnerships Lead, MarketWise Events
attachments: MDF_SOW_draft.pdf, Booth_Specs_v2.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Morales <sarah@marketwiseevents.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — initial MDF & booth ask

Thanks Sarah — large + clear ask. Quick answers from our side: 

1) MDF: can we take the 50/50 up to $25k for the full 4-city run? That aligns with our Q3 events budget but we need a short contract clause for carry-forward if one city cancels. Could you add a carry-forward clause (up to 40% of that city’s allocation) into the SOW?
2) API lead delivery: yes, please. Marcus will own the integration. We need a sample payload and an SLA for delivery (48 hours OK).
3) Shipping: we'll use MarketWise local storage for day-of, but Redwood will ship 2 crates for the first city to confirm fit.

Logistics questions for Marcus and Vanessa: can we staff 2 people per city (one AE + one Solutions engineer) or do we want to bring a third for NY? Also Vanessa — can design turn around co-branded social assets in 7 business days after you confirm logo usage?

I'll ask Contracts for a quick PO path if MarketWise can accept Redwood's standard PO (net 30).

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Sarah Morales <sarah@marketwiseevents.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — initial MDF & booth ask

On Tue, Jun 30, 2026 at 09:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen wrote:
> Logistics questions for Marcus and Vanessa: can we staff 2 people per city (one AE + one Solutions engineer) or do we want to bring a third for NY?

Stephanie — 2 people per city is fine, but for NYC we should consider adding an SE for the evening meetup (more technical Qs). I'll budget for travel/meal stipend for a third person in NY only.

API lead delivery: please send the sample payload. I can assign an engineer to the webhook this week if Sarah can share test credentials.

Design turnaround: Vanessa, 7 business days is doable if we get final logo and copy by next Wednesday (7/8).

Also adding a note about booth power: the spec shows a single 120V outlet. If we need a monitor + laptop + phone charging we should purchase the "power pack" ($95/event). Recommend we add it for ROI on demos.

Marcus Lin
Field CTO, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Morales <sarah@marketwiseevents.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — initial MDF & booth ask

Thanks all — quick updates from design and ops: 

- Design: co-brand guidelines received (thanks). We can produce 1 hero banner + 2 social banners per city and a one-page handout. I'll need final logo (SVG) and color hex for MarketWise by 7/8 to make the 7 business day SLA.
- Shipping: ops confirms crate dims in Booth_Specs_v2.pdf. If Redwood ships two crates, please ensure each crate has a packing list and contact phone on the label. MarketWise prefers local drayage for inbound/outbound — cost estimate attached.
- MDF SOW: Contracts will need a short addendum that notes PO acceptance and carry-forward allowances. I'll loop Legal if Sarah can provide the MarketWise PO template.

Vanessa Ortiz
Event Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: CoBrand_Guidelines.png

From: Sarah Morales <sarah@marketwiseevents.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 18:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: East Coast Roadshow — initial MDF & booth ask

Hi team — appreciate the quick responses. A few confirmations and next steps: 

- MarketWise accepts the 50/50 MDF match up to $25k for the 4-city run. I've added a short carry-forward line (up to 40% per city) into the attached SOW. Please review and confirm by EOD Friday so Legal can finalize.
- We'll provide the sample API payload and test credentials by tomorrow morning. Delivery SLA = 48 hours post-event.
- Power pack: approved; we'll add it to your invoice as a pass-through line item per event (approx $95).
- Lead sharing: MarketWise will send badge-scan CSVs within 24 hours for bronze leads and 48 hours for full richer payloads. If Redwood needs contacts pushed to CRM we will set up the webhook.

Next actions: 
1) Stephanie — confirm PO path (we can accept Redwood net-30 PO or process on our side).
2) Marcus — I’ll DM test creds; please confirm webhook endpoint by EOM.
3) Vanessa — send final logo + brand colors by 7/8; we’ll queue your art for first city.

Attaching updated SOW with carry-forward clause and revised booth spec with a small note on crate weight limits.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Morales
Partnerships Lead, MarketWise Events
attachments: MDF_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, Booth_Specs_v2.pdf
